description: Submits a request for Sherah's help with one task, on behalf of a person in the US and with details that person provides: the task in their own words, the date they need it done by, their email address, city and two-letter US state. Sherah is a personal-assistant service for families. If the email address is new to Sherah, Sherah emails the person an invitation to create an account, and the task is waiting for them after sign-up. Returns whether the request was submitted and a message for the person.

email.description: The person's own email address. The invitation is sent here.

needed_by.description: The date the person needs it done by, as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-01. No time and no timezone.

state.description: The person's US state, as a two-letter USPS code (for example TX).

task.description: What the person needs done, in their own words (up to 2,000 characters).

name: request_sign_up_with_task
title: Request Sign-Up With a Task
